# Check what changed after MOUSE on right square
def get_blue_positions(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    positions = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            positions.append((n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1], n['pixels']))
    positions.sort()
    return positions

# Compare current vs previous
current_blues = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
prev_blues = get_blue_positions(previous_frame)
print(f"Current blues: {current_blues}")
print(f"Previous blues: {prev_blues}")

# Check all nodes for changes
current_nodes = {(n['color'], n['pixels'], n['hash']) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']}
prev_nodes = {(n['color'], n['pixels'], n['hash']) for n in previous_frame.segmentation['nodes']}
print(f"\nCurrent node types: {current_nodes}")
print(f"Previous node types: {prev_nodes}")
print(f"New nodes: {current_nodes - prev_nodes}")
print(f"Removed nodes: {prev_nodes - current_nodes}")

# Count colors
from collections import Counter
current_colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
prev_colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in previous_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
print(f"\nCurrent colors: {dict(current_colors)}")
print(f"Previous colors: {dict(prev_colors)}")

# Try clicking the right square again
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 51, 'col': 36}])
print(f"\nAfter 2nd click: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
current_blues = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
print(f"Current blues: {current_blues}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
